name: FleetSheet — API on RapidAPI
description:
Decode a whole fleet list in one call: FleetSheet takes up to 25 VINs and returns the full NHTSA vPIC decode for each — make, model, body, fuel, plant and more — plus a fleet summary with field-coverage and make/body/fuel breakdowns.

What you get:
- The complete vPIC field set per VIN (396 fields tracked), identical to decoding one by one
- Honest per-VIN outcomes: decoded, sparse (partial data) or failed, with checksum-suspect VINs flagged separately
- A summary with denominators: coverage percentages and breakdowns by make, body class and fuel type
- Built for intake pipelines: auctions, fleet onboarding, insurance and parts catalogs

Key endpoints:
- POST /decode/batch — decode up to 25 VINs in one call
- GET /decode — decode one VIN
- GET /health — service status

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
